sections.title: Side Quests
sections.note: 50 Side Quests. None are permanently missable (Game8).

items.name: Finding the Flying Plant
items.howTo: Jacint wants the 'flying plant' he saw near the caves in Suthorn Forest: summon a Peahat Echo in front of him.

items.name: What Is Snow...Really?
items.howTo: The boy next to the village shop wants to see snow: summon a Snowball (or Snomaul) Echo.
items.notes: The Snowball Echo is learned on Hebra Mountain (Rift on Holy Mount Lanayru).

items.name: Up a Wall
items.howTo: Verley is stuck on a wall surrounded by monsters: defeat the two Spear Moblins.

items.name: The Blocked Road
items.area: Suthorn Prairie, northwest of the ruins
items.howTo: A man's shortcut to Hyrule Ranch is blocked: Bind away the boxes and boulders.

items.name: The Flying Tile
items.howTo: Tormali needs a Flying Tile for her boss Facette: summon a Flying Tile Echo for her.

items.name: Elusive Tumbleweeds
items.howTo: A Gerudo obsessed with tumbleweeds wants one intact: bring her a tumbleweed from the desert without it breaking.

items.name: Beetle Ballyhoo
items.howTo: Raslett, an off-duty soldier, asks you to destroy the beetle mounds in the cave northeast of town, then report back.

items.name: Gerudo Tag Training
items.howTo: An off-duty Gerudo soldier challenges you to tag: catch her (think creatively, e.g. Bind or Echoes).

items.name: Tornado Ghost?
items.howTo: A Gerudo saw a face in a tornado: summon a Tornando Echo to show her.

items.name: Wild Sandstorms
items.howTo: Two soldiers race to beat a new, stronger Lanmola: defeat it in the desert and report back.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki: appears only after you have already defeated two Lanmola in the Gerudo Desert.

items.name: Dohna's Challenge
items.howTo: Dohna dares you to sneak through the guarded Treasury (palace 2F, west side) and open the chest at the end.

items.name: Deliver the Grilled Fish!
items.howTo: Anube's mother asks you to take her huge Grilled Fish to Anube in the Woods to the North, then report back.

items.name: A Treat for My Person
items.howTo: Wearing Cat Clothes, talk to the cat: bring her a Warm Mixed Special smoothie (Warm Pepper + Refreshing Grapes, Electro Apple, Fresh Milk or Tough Mango).
items.notes: Needs Cat Clothes from 'Questioning the Local Cats' (or Black Cat Clothes via amiibo); outfits can be changed after Still Missing.

items.name: The Zappy Shipwreck
items.area: Seesyde Village (man on the boat-house roof)
items.howTo: Pry open the hatch of the Wrecked Ship in southwestern Zora Cove and defeat the jellyfish monster (Bori) inside, then report back.

items.name: The Zora Child's Fate
items.howTo: Medaka asks you to check on his mother. Show her three monster Echoes in turn: a 'sinister' fish monster, a monster that goes BOOM when approached, and a shocking jellyfish monster.
items.after: After Chaos at River Zora Village

items.name: Precious Treasure
items.howTo: A Sea Zora needs something pretty to keep his treasure in that won't spill underwater: show him a suitable box Echo.

items.name: Out of Bubble Kelp
items.area: Zora Cove Smoothie Shop (near Crossflows Plaza)
items.howTo: Give the Business Scrub 3 Bubble Kelp so the shop can open.

items.name: Big Shot
items.howTo: Defeat the two Chompfins and two Bombfish around the stalled boat, then tell the River Zora boy on it that it's safe.

items.name: Secret Chief Talks
items.area: Zora Cove (outcrop east of Sea Zora Village)
items.howTo: Rogma is worried about Kushara's secret meetings: ask around (Dradd's assistant Inawa, then Tellum) and find both chiefs in a cave in Zora Cove.

items.name: Runaway Horse
items.howTo: The ranch owner's horse has run off to the west: find her and bring her back.
items.reward: Free horse rental at Hyrule Ranch

items.name: Let's Play a Game
items.howTo: Archaeologist Sago is too scared to enter: clear the Eastern Temple and defeat Smog, then tell Sago.

items.name: The Great Fairy's Request
items.howTo: Open the new chest in the shrine; the Great Fairy wants a pendant. Ask the Gerudo artisan in Gerudo Town, bring her a floral seashell and a magma stone, then take the Lovely Pendant to the Great Fairy.
items.after: After The Rift on Eldin Volcano
items.notes: Also requires all 5 accessory slots bought and having talked to Lueburry about Might Crystals (Zelda Wiki).

items.name: A Curious Child
items.howTo: Euca wants to see Zols: summon a Zol, then an Ignizol, then a Hydrozol.

items.name: Impa's Gift
items.howTo: Impa raised a horse for you: go to Hyrule Ranch, then mend the rift in the carrot patch northwest of the castle and lure the spooked horse with a carrot.
items.notes: Opens a small rift (Stilled Carrot Patch).

items.name: One Soldier Too Many
items.howTo: Beecher says an Echo is hiding among the soldiers: talk to the soldiers and find the one with broken equipment, then tell Beecher.

items.name: From the Heart
items.howTo: Romi gives you a 'happy clover' for the King, then goes missing: track her across Hyrule Field to a rift near her dog and mend it, then speak to the King.
items.notes: Opens a small rift that also counts for Tri's level.

items.name: Automaton Engineer Dampé
items.howTo: Find Dampé arguing with a Crow (near the Eternal Forest entrance, north of Hyrule Ranch or northwest of Lake Hylia), defeat it to get his clockwork key back, then visit his studio and show him Tektite and Mothula Echoes.
items.reward: Techtite Automaton; Clockwork Key; Twisted Pumpkin x5

items.name: Explosions Galore!
items.howTo: Read Dampé's Journal! and show him an Octorok (stone-spitting) Echo and a Firework.
items.notes: The Firework comes from Basa, the fireworks artist in Goron City (see 'The Fireworks Artist').

items.name: Performance Artist!
items.howTo: Show Dampé a Zol-type Echo and give him the Prismatic Music Box (Flag Race Middle Course under 25 s at Hyrule Ranch).
items.notes: Flag Races need your own horse (Impa's Gift).

items.name: Endless Stomach!
items.howTo: Show Dampé a Deku Baba Lv. 2 (or Bio Deku Baba) Echo and give him the Steel Trap (Acorn Gathering course in western Hyrule Field under 40 s).

items.name: Chop 'em in Two!
items.howTo: Show Dampé a Sword Moblin Echo and give him the Heirloom Katana (Slumber Dojo reward for 6 challenges).

items.name: Get Rich Quick!
items.howTo: Show Dampé a Crow (or Albatrawl) Echo and give him the Golden Fan (Mango Rush, Vibrant Seeds, 50+ mangoes).

items.name: An Out-There Zol
items.howTo: Euca now wants a flashy, never-seen Zol: summon the Gizmol Automaton.

items.name: Cuccos on the Loose
items.howTo: Catch the five escaped Cuccos around the village and return them to the pen.

items.name: Questioning the Local Cats
items.howTo: An old man's cat is missing. Dig up the rupees buried under a cat for the woman by the shop to get her Cat Clothes, ask the village cats, find the cat in Hyrule Field, then check back in Kakariko.

items.name: The Fireworks Artist
items.howTo: Basa needs Blastpowder Soil: dig it up where the golden flowers bloom high on Eldin Volcano and bring it back.

items.name: Ready? Set? Goron!
items.howTo: Win a Goron Race to the flag (Platboom and Flying Tile Echoes help).
items.after: After The Rift on Eldin Volcano

items.name: Glide Path
items.area: Eastern cliff edge, east of Goron City
items.howTo: Show Seko how to glide: hold onto a flying Echo and reach the flag without touching the ground.
items.notes: Game8: if not done before Lands of the Goddesses, it returns after The Rift on Eldin Volcano.

items.name: Glide Path Trailblazer
items.area: Eastern cliff edge, east of Goron City
items.howTo: Disian's harder course: glide the 'Eldin Death Road of Pain' to the flag, using geysers and dodging falling rocks.
items.after: After The Rift on Eldin Volcano

items.name: The Flames of Fortune
items.area: Hot spring between Rock-Roast Quarry and Lizalfos Burrow
items.howTo: Ondes asks you to carry burning coal to Limme at the Goron City entrance.
items.after: After The Rift on Eldin Volcano

items.name: A Mountainous Mystery
items.howTo: Talk to Gol in Goron City, find Darston at the Summit Cave in northern Eldin Volcano, clear the cave and defeat the flame giant (Volcanic Talus), then tell Darston.
items.after: After The Rift on Eldin Volcano
items.notes: Unlock conditions disagree: Game8 says also complete 'Automaton Engineer Dampé' and 'The Fireworks Artist'; Zelda Wiki (unsourced) says 'The Zappy Shipwreck', 'Let's Play a Game', 'Cotton-Candy Hunt' and General Wright's monster rumours. Mini-dungeon: Summit Cave.

items.name: Getting It Twisted
items.area: West Hebra Mountain, northwest of Condé's House
items.howTo: Give the Business Scrub a Twisted Pumpkin so the Smoothie Shop can open.

items.name: Stamp Stand Swallowed!
items.area: Small rift on the Holy Mount Lanayru ascent (north Hebra Mountain)
items.howTo: The Stamp Guy's stand was swallowed: enter the small rift (Stilled Hebra Mountain Passage per Game8), rescue Tri's friends on three islets and mend it.
items.after: During/after Rift on Holy Mount Lanayru
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon lists 'complete Hyrule Castle' as the condition; the area is only reachable during the Hebra main quest.

items.name: Snowball Magic
items.howTo: Carry a special snowball to the pedestal in northwest Hebra Mountain to show Condé the weather-changing 'magic'.
items.after: After Rift on Holy Mount Lanayru

items.name: The Mythical Deku Snake
items.howTo: Give the Deku Scrub three Electro Apples.
items.after: After A Rift in the Faron Wetlands

items.name: Mobbing Mothulas!
items.area: Scrubton (southwest; Bind the burrowed scrub out)
items.howTo: Defeat the swarm of Mothulas in the southeastern Faron Wetlands, then report back.
items.after: After A Rift in the Faron Wetlands

items.name: The Rain-Making Monster
items.howTo: Show the Deku Scrub the monster that makes rain: summon a Drippitune Echo (found north of Scrubton).

items.name: Looking for Bempu
items.howTo: Hide-and-seek with Bempu in four rounds: The Sweet Spot, Heart Lake, the centre of the four stone 'siblings', then Blossu's House.
items.after: After A Rift in the Faron Wetlands

items.name: Cotton-Candy Hunt
items.area: Scrubton (left of the waypoint) / Hidden Ruins
items.howTo: The 'cotton candy' in the building south of Scrubton is Smog: clear the Hidden Ruins, defeat Smog and report back.
items.after: After A Rift in the Faron Wetlands

items.name: Recipes, Please!
items.howTo: Starts when you blend your first smoothie. Register 10 new recipes, then 30 in total.
items.notes: Out of Bubble Kelp and Getting It Twisted open two more shops.
